GUARDIAN_BASE_CHALLENGE_PRACTICE.why: Every Guardian has the core rules Interpose and Held Harm (Sphere Compendium, Core Guardian Rules); this practice marks a Guardian (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). The Challenge action itself still compiles. Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

GUARDIAN_BASE_PATROL_PRACTICE.why: Patrol Practice marks a Guardian (Interpose, Held Harm: combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py); the Patrol action compiles to the guardian_patrol effect (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_BODYGUARD.why: Bodyguard: Interpose reaches 20 feet, moves 20 feet and gives Resistance to the triggering attack (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_DEEP_RESERVOIR.why: Deep Reservoir: the Held Harm Pool maximum rises by your CL (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_DURABLE.why: Durable: after a failed save against a listed condition, reserve 10 Held Harm space and delay it to the end of your next turn (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_COLD_IRON_CALL.why: Cold Iron Call: reserve 5 x the originator's PB of Held Harm space to delay a supernatural condition (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_PUNISHMENT_RETURNED.why: Punishment Returned: a melee hit while Held Harm holds damage returns it (CON save, half) or transmits a delayed effect, for Martial Focus once a round (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_GUARDIAN_S_FOCUS.why: Guardian's Focus: Martial Focus back once a round after a successful Interpose, a Patrol attack hit or a Challenged creature dropping to 0 HP (combat/ext/guardian_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_COMPLEX_PATROL.why: Complex Patrol: two Zone talents on one Patrol for Martial Focus (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_STEEL_HEDGE.why: Steel Hedge (Zone talent): hostile creatures treat the Patrol Zone as difficult terrain (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.guardian.assist_the_line.why: Assist the Line (Zone talent): allies inside the Patrol Zone gain +1 AC (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.guardian.clear_path.why: Clear Path (Zone talent): allies moving through the Patrol Zone provoke no opportunity attacks from hostile creatures (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_STAND_STILL.why: Stand Still (Zone talent): a Patrol attack hit sets the creature's Speed to 0 until its next turn (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_GUARDIAN_SINGULARITY_PATROL.why: Singularity Patrol (Zone talent): a hostile creature starting its turn in the Patrol Zone is pulled toward you on a failed Strength save (combat/ext/guardian_patrol.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_BRUTE_GREATER_BRUTE.why: Greater Brute: Expertise in Brute contests and explicitly identified Strength (Athletics) checks; AUTO51 uses the existing d20 bonus hook.

TAL_BRUTE_BRUTAL_MANHANDLE.why: Brutal Manhandle: a second Manhandle talent on a successful shove for Martial Focus (combat/ext/brute_shove.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.brute.alternative_maneuve.why: Alternative Maneuvers: no Disadvantage on Shove Aside; an Overrun deals Brutal Shove damage and applies a Manhandle talent (combat/ext/brute_shove.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_BRUTE_MIGHTY_HURL.why: Mighty Hurl: Throw's extra movement is 20 feet instead of 10 (combat/ext/brute_shove.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SOW_LIVING_CLAIM.why: Sow Living Claim marks a Verdant Growth cultivator: Living Claims, Growth Marks and the Verdant Responses (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py, which also compiles the Sow Living Claim button at a square). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_FEED_THE_ROOT.why: Feed the Root: once per turn, a Growth Mark placed on a creature touching your claim feeds a claim with Root Feed (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_BARK_BACK_GUARD.why: Bark-Back Guard: a claim sown on your body gives PB Temporary HP; the first melee hitter takes PB Piercing (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_BRAMBLE_REFUSAL.why: Bramble Refusal: spend a mark when a marked creature attacks you or an ally by your claim in melee (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py before_attack). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_HUNGRY_ROOT_DRINKS_TH.why: Hungry Root: a creature healed while touching your claim may gain a Growth Mark (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_MEDICINAL_SPROUT.why: Medicinal Sprout: Shelter also gives Advantage on the next Constitution save against Poisoned (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_REED_SCREEN.why: Reed Screen: Shelter's screen lasts 1 minute or until the claim is destroyed (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SHELTER_GROVE_POSTURE.why: Shelter-Grove Posture: two Shelter options (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_ROOT_SNARE_STEP.why: AUTO36: Root-Snare uses physical distance and the strict landed-step checkpoint; older compiled rows keep post-move behavior.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_STAFF_BECOMES_BRANCH.why: Staff Becomes Branch: once per turn a wooden-weapon hit places a Growth Mark (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_THORNED_WARNING.why: Thorned Warning: a creature that harms your claim gains a mark; Thorn on it adds your key modifier (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_THORN_CROWN_REVERSAL.why: Thorn Crown Reversal: spend up to 3 marks of a marked enemy hurting an ally (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py final_damage). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_WILLOW_BEND_DEFENSE.why: Willow-Bend Defense: forced movement on you while touching a Living Medium is 10 feet shorter (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_FOREST_REMEMBERS_THE_.why: Forest Remembers the Path: a marked creature moving within 60 feet may leave a claim behind for a mark (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SEED_POUCH_METHOD.why: Seed Pouch Method: you always carry a Living Medium (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py contact rules). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.verdant_growth.branching_.why: Branching Answer Scripture: a second different Verdant Response once per round, no mark (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.verdant_growth.rooted_lin.why: Rooted Lineage Scripture: a marked enemy starting its turn on your claim loses 5 feet of Speed (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py). Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.verdant_growth.verdant_in.why: Verdant Incarnation: a free claim on your body each turn, marks on melee hitters, Bind for one mark (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py); the Bonus Action still compiles. Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_GROVE_DOMAIN_COURT_OF.why: Grove Domain: a free claim each turn, marks and Temporary HP at turn start in your claims, a free response a round, claims difficult for enemies (combat/ext/verdant_chassis.py); the Bonus Action still compiles. Rider lane C16, 2026-09-30.

tianxia.talent.force.pressure_sense.why: AUTO87 2026-10-05: Pressure Sense marks its owner so combat/ext/force.py can tell it when one of its own anchors moved with the creature it rests on, ended, or was crossed by a creature. The other two printed clauses (an anchor struck for its own sake, an anchor separated by a planar boundary) have nothing to happen on this table and stay a GM line.
